shortDescription: Manages XML file content on Windows hosts

options.name: attribute
options.description: The attribute name if the type is 'attribute'. Required if C(type=attribute).

options.name: backup
options.description: Determine whether a backup should be created. When set to C(yes), create a backup file including the timestamp information so you can get the original file back if you somehow clobbered it incorrectly.

options.name: content
options.description: Returns the content of the nodes matched by I(xpath).

options.name: count
options.description: When set to C(yes), return the number of nodes matched by I(xpath).

options.name: fragment
options.description: The string representation of the XML fragment expected at xpath.  Since ansible 2.9 not required when I(state=absent) or when I(count=yes). Not required when I(content) is set.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the file to operate on.

options.name: preserve_whitespace
options.description: Whether to preserve whitespace in the XML.

options.name: state
options.description: Set or remove the nodes (or attributes) matched by I(xpath).

options.name: type
options.description: The type of XML node you are working with.

options.name: xpath
options.description: Xpath to select the node or nodes to operate on.
